ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixel distribution occupying approximately 85-90% of the visible area, contrasted against low-intensity (black) pixel borders and localized internal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white field across both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation mapped continuously along the trailing edge and tips; localized low-intensity linear cluster on left mid-lobe; isolated low-intensity circular spot on right mid-lower lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 105 degrees at the center of the vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of approximately 5-20 pixels; highest amplitude peaks observed at the lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile extending from the median notch to the lateral tips, with curvature increasing in the distal thirds of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast dark clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; isolated dark circular pixel cluster on the right lobe interior.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct diagonal low-intensity linear mark on the upper left lobe; multiple smaller vertical low-intensity streaks clustered near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular pigmentation and structural erosion at the distal tips, likely indicating historic barnacle colonization or mechanical abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique spatial pairing of a single diagonal linear mark on the left lobe and a solitary circular spot on the right lobe.
